page.layout: One printed page: running head with page number at top; a large oval engraved portrait with an inscribed legend around its border; below the portrait, a four-line verse caption in italic type.
page.notes: Engraving: oval portrait of a woman in a headdress and ruff, with a legend around the border reading "MARGARETA AUSTRIACA. DUCISSA PARMÆ ET PLACENTIÆ; GOV..." (the right and lower part of the legend is cut off by the page edge, so the remainder is illegible). The portrait is described here, not transcribed as text.
page.l: Machiauelle tuas quid me tentasse per artes
